part_171.title: 49 CFR Part 171 — General Information, Regulations, and Definitions

definitions.definition: A material that, when offered for transportation or transported in a bulk packaging, is in a liquid phase and at a temperature at or above 100°C (212°F); or a material that is in a liquid phase with a flash point at or above 37.8°C (100°F) that is intentionally heated and offered for transportation or transported at or above its flash point; or in a solid phase and at a temperature at or above 240°C (464°F).
definitions.relevance: Triggers Class 9 classification and special shipping paper notations (HOT).

definitions.definition: A material, including its mixtures and solutions, that is listed in the appendix to §172.101, is in a quantity in one package that equals or exceeds the reportable quantity (RQ) listed in that appendix, and when in a mixture or solution, is in a concentration by weight which equals or exceeds the concentration listed in §171.8.
definitions.relevance: Requires RQ notation on shipping papers.

definitions.definition: A material listed in the appendix to §172.101 with a 'P' in column 1.
definitions.relevance: Requires 'Marine Pollutant' notation on shipping papers; special segregation requirements.

definitions.definition: A grouping (PG I, II, or III) according to the degree of danger presented by hazardous materials. PG I = great danger; PG II = medium danger; PG III = minor danger.
definitions.relevance: Must be verified on shipping paper and matches §172.101 table.

definitions.definition: The primary name of the hazardous material as listed in §172.101 Table, Column 2.
definitions.relevance: Must appear on shipping paper exactly as listed; no abbreviations unless authorized.

part_172_subpart_c.title: 49 CFR Part 172, Subpart C — Shipping Papers

sections.title: Applicability
sections.rule: Every person offering a hazardous material for transportation must describe it on shipping papers as required by this subpart.
exceptions: Materials marked 'A' in §172.101 Table Column 1 (except air transport)
Materials marked 'W' in §172.101 Table Column 1 (except water transport)
Limited quantity packages (except air or vessel transport)

audit_check.question: Is a shipping paper present for this DG shipment?
audit_check.pass: Shipping paper is present and covers all HM entries.
audit_check.fail: No shipping paper present for a regulated hazardous material.
audit_check.warning: Shipping paper present but may be missing required entries — check §172.202.
audit_check.unable_to_verify: Document not legible or not provided.

sections.title: Preparation and Retention of Shipping Papers

rules.rule: Hazardous material descriptions must appear first on the shipping paper OR be in a contrasting color OR be marked with 'X' or 'RQ' in a column captioned 'HM'.

audit_check.question: Is the HM description clearly distinguished from non-HM entries on the shipping paper?
audit_check.pass: HM entry is first, contrasting color, or 'X'/'RQ' marked in HM column.
audit_check.fail: HM entries are not distinguishable from non-HM entries.
audit_check.warning: Unclear presentation — verify HM column or ordering.

rules.rule: The shipping paper and all copies must be legible and printed in English.

audit_check.question: Is the shipping paper legible and in English?
audit_check.pass: Legible, printed in English.
audit_check.fail: Not in English or not legible.
audit_check.warning: Partially legible or bilingual — English portion must contain all required fields.

rules.rule: No codes or abbreviations unless specifically authorized.

audit_check.question: Does the shipping paper use any unauthorized codes or abbreviations?
audit_check.pass: No unauthorized codes or abbreviations found.
audit_check.fail: Unauthorized abbreviations or codes are present.
audit_check.warning: Abbreviations present — verify each is specifically authorized.

rules.rule: Emergency response telephone number required on shipping paper.

audit_check.question: Is an emergency response telephone number present on the shipping paper?
audit_check.pass: Emergency response number is present.
audit_check.fail: No emergency response telephone number on shipping paper.
audit_check.warning: Number present but may not be 24-hr accessible — flag for review.

rules.rule: Shipping papers must be retained for 2 years (3 years for hazardous waste) after acceptance by initial carrier. Must include acceptance date.

audit_check.question: Is the date of carrier acceptance noted on the shipping paper?
audit_check.pass: Acceptance date is present.
audit_check.fail: No acceptance date noted.
audit_check.warning: Date present but format is unclear.

sections.title: Description of Hazardous Material on Shipping Papers — Required Basic Description
sections.rule: The basic description must appear in this exact sequence: (1) UN/NA ID Number, (2) Proper Shipping Name, (3) Hazard Class or Division, (4) Packing Group (in Roman numerals). No additional information may be interspersed.

audit_check.question: Is a valid UN/NA ID number present and correctly formatted?
audit_check.pass: UN/NA number present and matches §172.101 Table for the stated material.
audit_check.fail: UN/NA number absent, incorrect, or does not match the proper shipping name.
audit_check.warning: Number present but not verified against §172.101 — flag for cross-check.

required_elements.format: Must be the primary listed name; technical name in parentheses if 'G' in Column 1

audit_check.question: Is the proper shipping name correct, unabbreviated, and matching the §172.101 Table?
audit_check.pass: PSN matches §172.101 Table exactly for the stated UN number.
audit_check.fail: PSN is missing, abbreviated, or does not match the UN number.
audit_check.warning: PSN present but uses 'n.o.s.' without a required technical name in parentheses.

required_elements.format: Primary class followed by subsidiary class(es) in parentheses if required

audit_check.question: Is the primary hazard class and any required subsidiary hazard class present and correct?
audit_check.pass: Hazard class matches §172.101 Table; subsidiary classes correctly noted in parentheses.
audit_check.fail: Hazard class missing, incorrect, or subsidiary class omitted when required.
audit_check.warning: Hazard class present but subsidiary class notation unclear.

required_elements.format: Roman numerals: PG I, PG II, or PG III (may be preceded by 'PG')
exceptions: Entries with no assigned packing group

audit_check.question: Is the packing group present in Roman numerals and correct for this material?
audit_check.pass: Packing group is present in Roman numerals and matches §172.101 Table.
audit_check.fail: Packing group missing or incorrect.
audit_check.warning: Packing group present but not in Roman numeral format — flag.

required_elements.format: Ground: total quantity with unit of measure (e.g., '200 kg', '50 L'). Air: net mass per package or gross mass if indicated.

audit_check.question: Is the total quantity of hazardous material stated with correct units?
audit_check.pass: Quantity and unit of measure are present and appropriate for the mode of transport.
audit_check.fail: Quantity missing or unit of measure absent.
audit_check.warning: Quantity present but unit of measure may not match the mode of transport requirements.

audit_check.question: Is the number and type of packages stated?
audit_check.pass: Number and type of packages clearly stated.
audit_check.fail: Package count or type is missing.
audit_check.warning: Package type abbreviated — verify abbreviation is commonly accepted.

sequence_check.rule: Basic description must appear in order: UN/NA Number → PSN → Hazard Class → Packing Group. No information may be inserted between these four elements.

audit_check.question: Is the basic description in the correct required sequence?
audit_check.pass: UN number, PSN, hazard class, PG appear in correct order with no interspersed data.
audit_check.fail: Elements are out of sequence or information is inserted between required elements.
audit_check.warning: Sequence appears correct but technical name placement needs verification.

sequence_check.example_note: The incorrect example varies SEQUENCE only — the UN number and the proper shipping name are transposed. Hazard class and packing group are unchanged so the teaching point is unambiguous.

additional_fields.rule: Must show 'DOT-SP' followed by special permit number when shipment is under a special permit.

audit_check.question: If a special permit applies, is 'DOT-SP [number]' noted on the shipping paper?
audit_check.pass: DOT-SP notation present and associated with the correct description.
audit_check.fail: Special permit shipment has no DOT-SP notation.
audit_check.warning: DOT-SP notation present but number is not readable.

additional_fields.rule: Must include 'Limited Quantity' or 'Ltd Qty' following the basic description.

audit_check.question: If offered as limited quantity, is 'Limited Quantity' or 'Ltd Qty' noted?
audit_check.pass: LQ designation present following basic description.
audit_check.fail: LQ shipment has no LQ notation on shipping paper.

additional_fields.rule: The letters 'RQ' must appear before or after the basic description for each hazardous substance meeting RQ threshold.

audit_check.question: If this is a hazardous substance meeting RQ, is 'RQ' noted on the shipping paper?
audit_check.pass: 'RQ' present before or after basic description.
audit_check.fail: RQ threshold met but 'RQ' notation missing.
audit_check.not_applicable: Material does not meet RQ threshold.

additional_fields.rule: For air shipments, must state whether the shipment is within limitations for passenger and cargo aircraft OR cargo aircraft only.

audit_check.question: For air shipments, is the passenger/cargo or cargo-only aircraft statement present?
audit_check.pass: Statement present and correct for the material's air eligibility.
audit_check.fail: Air transport statement missing from air shipment documentation.
audit_check.warning: Statement present but does not clearly specify passenger+cargo vs. cargo-only.

additional_fields.rule: If a liquid meets elevated temperature definition and 'Molten' or 'Elevated temperature' is not in the PSN, the word 'HOT' must immediately precede the PSN.

audit_check.question: For elevated temperature liquids, does 'HOT' precede the PSN if not already in the name?
audit_check.pass: 'HOT' is present preceding the PSN, or 'Molten'/'Elevated temperature' is in the PSN.
audit_check.fail: Elevated temperature liquid with no 'HOT' notation and no indication in PSN.
audit_check.not_applicable: Material is not an elevated temperature material.

additional_fields.rule: Words 'Marine Pollutant' shall appear in association with the basic description. For n.o.s. entries, the name of the pollutant component must appear in parentheses.

audit_check.question: If material is a marine pollutant, are 'Marine Pollutant' words and component name present?
audit_check.pass: 'Marine Pollutant' noted; component name in parentheses if n.o.s. entry.
audit_check.fail: Marine pollutant designation missing from shipping paper.
audit_check.not_applicable: Material is not a marine pollutant.

additional_fields.rule: If PSN is marked 'G' in §172.101 Column 1, the technical name of the hazardous constituent must appear in parentheses in association with the basic description.

audit_check.question: For 'G'-marked n.o.s. entries, is the technical name in parentheses with the description?
audit_check.pass: Technical name in parentheses correctly identifies the hazardous constituent.
audit_check.fail: n.o.s. entry with 'G' designation has no technical name in parentheses.
audit_check.warning: Technical name present but may not identify the primary hazardous constituent.

sections.title: Shipper's Certification
sections.rule: For most shipments, the shipper must certify on the shipping paper that the material is properly classified, described, packaged, marked, and labeled and is in proper condition for transport.
sections.certification_text_ground: This is to certify that the above-named materials are properly classified, described, packaged, marked, and labeled, and are in proper condition for transportation according to the applicable regulations of the Department of Transportation.
sections.certification_text_air: I hereby declare that the contents of this consignment are fully and accurately described above by the proper shipping name, and are classified, packaged, marked and labeled/placarded, and are in all respects in proper condition for transport according to applicable international and national governmental regulations.

audit_check.question: Is the shipper's certification present and complete on the shipping paper?
audit_check.pass: Certification present, signed, and contains required language for the mode of transport.
audit_check.fail: Certification missing, unsigned, or uses incorrect language.
audit_check.warning: Certification present but signature, date, or company name is missing.

missing_sections.note: Part 172 coverage stops at Subpart C. The subparts below are NOT integrated. Note that §172.204 certifies the consignment is "marked and labeled/placarded" — this library cannot currently audit any of that.

sections.covers: Marking — UN number and PSN on package, orientation arrows
Labeling — Class 9 label, subsidiary labels, CARGO AIRCRAFT ONLY
Placarding — road leg to the gateway
Emergency response information and telephone number monitoring
HazMat employee training, recurrent every three years, records

part_173_class_3.title: 49 CFR Part 173 — Class 3: Flammable Liquids

definition.class_3_flammable_liquid: A liquid having a flash point of not more than 60°C (140°F), OR any material in liquid phase with a flash point at or above 37.8°C (100°F) that is intentionally heated and offered for transport at or above its flash point in a bulk packaging.
definition.flash_point_definition: The minimum temperature at which a liquid gives off vapor in sufficient concentration to form an ignitable mixture with air near the surface of the liquid.
definition.combustible_liquid: A liquid with a flash point above 60°C (140°F) and below 93°C (200°F) that does not meet any other hazard class definition.

exceptions_from_class_3: Liquid meeting another hazard class definition per §173.115
Mixture with ≥99% components having flash point ≥60°C not transported at or above flash point
Liquid with flash point >35°C that does not sustain combustion per ASTM D4206 or Appendix H
Liquid with flash point >35°C and fire point >100°C per ISO 2592
Liquid with flash point >35°C in water-miscible solution with >90% water by mass

packing_groups.warning: UNVERIFIED AND DISPUTED. The packing group criteria for Class 3 are assigned by §173.121, which this library does not yet contain (finding F-09); the source below points at the Hazardous Materials Table, which lists assignments rather than criteria. The PG I flash point threshold shown is disputed — reviewer understanding is that §173.121 assigns PG I on initial boiling point alone. Do not score C3-002 from this table until §173.121 is integrated.

audit_checklist.pass: Flash point on document matches SDS within acceptable test method variance.
audit_checklist.fail: Flash point on document does not match SDS; or flash point is missing from documents.
audit_checklist.warning: Flash point present on document but SDS not available for cross-reference.
audit_checklist.unable_to_verify: Neither document nor SDS provides flash point data.

audit_checklist.question: Is the stated packing group (PG I, II, or III) correct for the flash point and boiling point of this material?
audit_checklist.pass: Packing group matches the flash point criteria for the assigned group.
audit_checklist.fail: Packing group does not correspond to the stated flash point.
audit_checklist.warning: Packing group present but flash point data is not sufficient to verify.

audit_checklist.check: Proper shipping name matches UN number
audit_checklist.question: Does the proper shipping name correspond to the UN number in the §172.101 Table?
audit_checklist.pass: PSN and UN number match §172.101 Table.
audit_checklist.fail: PSN and UN number do not correspond in §172.101 Table.

audit_checklist.check: Flash point notation for water shipments
audit_checklist.question: For shipments by water, is the minimum flash point (if ≤60°C) noted on the shipping paper?
audit_checklist.pass: Flash point noted in association with basic description for water shipment.
audit_checklist.fail: Flash point not noted on shipping paper for water transport.

audit_checklist.question: If this Class 3 material is transported at or above its flash point in bulk, is the word 'HOT' preceding the PSN?
audit_checklist.pass: 'HOT' precedes the PSN, or 'Molten'/'Elevated temperature' is included in the PSN.
audit_checklist.fail: Elevated temperature Class 3 bulk shipment missing 'HOT' notation.
audit_checklist.not_applicable: Material not transported at or above flash point.

audit_checklist.pass: Reclassification properly noted or not applicable.

audit_checklist.warning: Reclassification may apply — flag for shipper review.
audit_checklist.note: Reclassification as combustible liquid does not apply to vessel or aircraft transport.

part_173_class_8.title: 49 CFR Part 173 — Class 8: Corrosive Materials
part_173_class_8.definition: A liquid or solid that causes irreversible damage to human skin at the site of contact within a specified period of time. Also includes liquids or solids that have a severe corrosion rate on steel or aluminum exceeding 6.25 mm/year at 55°C.

groups.criteria: Causes irreversible damage to intact skin within observation period of up to 60 minutes, starting after exposure of 3 minutes or less.
Causes irreversible damage to intact skin within observation period of up to 14 days, starting after exposure of more than 3 minutes but not more than 60 minutes.

Causes irreversible damage to intact skin within observation period of up to 14 days after exposure of more than 60 minutes but not more than 4 hours; OR exhibits corrosion rate on steel or aluminum exceeding 6.25 mm/year at 55°C.

test_methods_accepted: OECD Guideline Test No. 404 — Acute Dermal Irritation/Corrosion
OECD Guideline Test No. 430 — In Vitro Skin Corrosion (TER)
OECD Guideline Test No. 431 — In Vitro Skin Corrosion (RHE)
OECD Guideline Test No. 435 — In Vitro Membrane Barrier Test

part_173_class_9.title: 49 CFR Part 173 — Class 9: Miscellaneous Hazardous Materials
part_173_class_9.definition: A material which presents a hazard during transport but does not meet the definition of any other hazard class.

class_9_includes.description: Any material with anesthetic, noxious, or similar properties that could cause extreme annoyance or discomfort to a flight crew member so as to prevent correct performance of assigned duties.
Material meeting the definition in §171.8 for an elevated temperature material.
Material meeting the definition in §171.8 for a hazardous substance (RQ threshold).
Material meeting the definition in §171.8 for a hazardous waste.
Material meeting the definition in §171.8 for a marine pollutant.

pharma_temperature_sensitive.title: 49 CFR — Pharmaceutical / Temperature-Sensitive Shipments
pharma_temperature_sensitive.note: No single 49 CFR section governs all pharma shipments. Compliance draws from multiple sections. IATA DGR 67th Edition (and GDP guidelines) govern air transport of temperature-sensitive pharmaceuticals. This section captures the 49 CFR elements relevant to pharma documentation review.

part_175_air_transport.title: 49 CFR Part 175 — Carriage by Aircraft
part_175_air_transport.note: Part 175 governs U.S. domestic air transport of hazardous materials. For international air, IATA DGR 67th Edition governs and will be integrated as a separate library module.

key_sections.title: Exceptions for Passengers, Crewmembers, and Air Operators
key_sections.relevance: Defines what hazardous materials are permissible in carry-on or checked baggage. Critical for pharma shipments involving dry ice or personal use medical devices.

dry_ice_rule.rule: Dry ice (UN1845) for perishables may be carried by passengers: maximum 2.5 kg (5.5 lbs) per person. Package must permit release of CO2 gas. Checked baggage must be marked 'DRY ICE' or 'CARBON DIOXIDE, SOLID' with net weight.

audit_check.question: For passenger-carried dry ice: is quantity within 2.5 kg limit and is packaging marked correctly?
audit_check.pass: Quantity ≤2.5 kg; packaging marked 'DRY ICE' or 'CARBON DIOXIDE, SOLID' with net weight.
audit_check.fail: Quantity exceeds 2.5 kg limit or packaging not correctly marked.
audit_check.not_applicable: Dry ice is not passenger-carried in this shipment.

key_sections.scope_warning: This section governs PASSENGER and crewmember baggage only. It is NOT authority for commercial cargo consignments. Do not cite it on a cargo finding.

air_transport_shipping_paper_requirement.rule: For all air shipments, shipping paper must state whether shipment is within limitations for: (a) Passenger and cargo aircraft, OR (b) Cargo aircraft only.

audit_check.question: Is the passenger/cargo or cargo-only aircraft authorization statement present on the air shipping paper?
audit_check.pass: Statement present and consistent with the material's authorized air eligibility.
audit_check.fail: Statement missing from air shipment shipping paper.
audit_check.warning: Statement present but does not clearly specify which aircraft type is authorized.

quantity_per_package_air.rule: For air transport, the total net mass per package (not total shipment) must be shown on the shipping paper, unless gross mass is specified in §172.101 Table Columns 9A or 9B.

audit_check.question: Does the air shipping paper show net mass per package (or authorized gross mass per package)?
audit_check.pass: Net mass or authorized gross mass per package is stated on the shipping paper.
audit_check.fail: Air shipping paper shows only total shipment quantity, not per-package quantity.
audit_check.warning: Quantity present but unclear whether it is per-package or total.

missing_sections.note: Part 175 coverage is limited to §175.10, which is a passenger exception. The core air carrier sections below are NOT integrated.

sections.covers: Notification to pilot-in-command (NOTOC) — dry ice must appear on it
Quantity limitations and cargo location — dry ice loading limits
General requirements for transportation by aircraft — pressure differential, closures

finding_status_definitions.Pass: Document element is present, correct, and consistent with the cited regulation.
finding_status_definitions.Fail: Document element is missing, incorrect, or inconsistent with the cited regulation. Requires immediate flagging for human review.
finding_status_definitions.Warning: Document element is present but contains an anomaly or ambiguity that requires human verification before release.
finding_status_definitions.Unable_to_Verify: The required document or data element was not provided or is not legible. Cannot confirm compliance or non-compliance.
finding_status_definitions.Not_Applicable: The rule or check does not apply to this shipment type, mode, or material.
